folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B218, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
The complete original NA1–NA13 proposal and Nov3 H3/H4 supplement were read. Tern’s concrete local control transfer corrects blanket no-possession wording without proving a general lease executor. The later supplement preserves native goods/gear/stats/XP and simulation body identity, separates scheduling controllers from executive control, and identifies the existing code word seat as a perspective filter. Body owner, operator, current viewpoint and observer remain different references. These are source-inspected historical findings/proposed APIs, not newly inspected current exports (AD32/AD36).

Two scope tensions need explicit qualification. The original unknown-missing-body policy and later derived legacy-human bodyBinding can coexist only under the declared legacy compatibility basis; the proposed synthetic body.<person>.native ID is not proof every absent modern body is human. Second, free-form basis fields needing no schema-number migration do change persisted knowledge content. Their optional validation, serialization/restore, omitted-field readers and missing-source behavior still need actual proof. The supplement’s FLR5 recognizes this despite the phrase no save change. No invisible initialization, resource provisioning or knowledge copying follows from a pure read.

A carrier claim differs from an observer’s receipt of that claim and the observer’s belief. The opening all-three-in-knowledge shorthand must be read with its own later explanation that a claim lives on an utterance/document/object: writing a claim somewhere is not receipt by every observer. R-c’s body/persona subject is the observed presentation for that case, not a universal ban on channels that directly identify a controller/person. Perceived body, reported credential, present belief and actual protected controller stay distinct. A later correction adds evidence/history rather than rewriting old documents or other people’s private maps.

The Nov3 who-knows registration, exposedTo duplication, Polyjuice and ORV rows retain their actual proof levels. Polyjuice was a name grep explicitly marked UNKNOWN until full read; ORV name search is not an exhaustive absence census. A missing registration caller is not established by a visible column label. B153’s later bounded method/divination delivery does not automatically ship this proposed shared recognition reader, persona bridge or general perception layer. B215’s full social palette supplies complementary direction/recognition/custody qualifications without another social store.

The original universal second-real-consumer minimum, second-lease gate and three-case kernel reference need current AD51 qualification: a concrete known consumer can justify a seam, and a different world validates reuse. Retain narrow ownership and meaningful compatibility checks without delaying every first implementation for a fabricated example quota. Current desktop/prose-first targets replace retired1366-primary wording; the one-realm/prestige direction is retired. Keep actual useful body functions, no mandatory return to human, local fuel versus hunger, body loss versus person death, live return pointers versus rolling history, and unknown performance until measured. No new anatomy, control, age, perception, schema, migration or native behavior was implemented or tested here.
